gaps.title: Production authorities and transactional publication

Native KI/source exporters and calibrated semantic meaning assessment remain required; changed typed meaning remains review.
Full-stream high-resolution audiovisual and native game/Android browser coverage not established by finite PNG/Node samples.
Production hostile-code isolation, transitive dependency closure, distributed execution/durability and trustworthy clocks remain external.
Real-book content quality, benchmark and learner outcomes plus Section15 evidence remain required.

Governed installation/rebuild and identity verification of transitive third-party dependencies, shared libraries, OS/container images, fonts, GPU and external model snapshots.
Cross-machine, cross-platform and long/high-resolution media reproduction with bounded streaming and complete coverage.
Independent operational execution attestation, reviewer governance and tamper-resistant collector origin; hashes alone do not prove provenance.
Production worker and network isolation, crash recovery and distributed orchestration; trusted bounded subprocesses are not a hostile-code sandbox.
Finite matching outputs may be consistently wrong. All semantic, pedagogy, cinematic, actual render/game, regression and real-book gates remain mandatory.

Native rendered/deployed notices and source-offer availability; no metadata-only clearance.

batch020_open_obligations.title: Native generated-worker sandbox adoption
batch020_open_obligations.description: The bundled privileged bootstrap executes fixed trusted probes only. Wire approved production Python/Node/Chromium/Remotion/game workers to an independently reviewed isolation profile; do not use this diagnostic helper to launch candidate code.

batch020_open_obligations.title: Broader static and supply-chain coverage
batch020_open_obligations.description: General React/TypeScript/HTML/CSS/native code, transitive dependency inventory, taint/dataflow and vulnerability database checks remain unsupported or review-required. Operator-pinned third-party parser and interpreter integrity is not a vulnerability clearance.

batch020_open_obligations.title: Production isolation and attestation
batch020_open_obligations.description: Cgroups/namespaces/containers, aggregate memory/CPU/network quotas, kernel/runtime vulnerabilities, cross-platform profiles, privileged-bootstrap review and authenticated operational execution attestation remain open. Neither chroot nor seccomp is treated as sufficient alone.

batch020_open_obligations.title: Security assessment and real-book end-to-end proof
batch020_open_obligations.description: All positive review keys are synthetic fixtures. Actual assessor calibration, independent red-team review, native pipeline integration, regression and product security acceptance remain unverified.

audit001_findings.title: Unregistered terminal report schemas can clear publication assessment
audit001_findings.description: The code tests top-level success fields but has no terminal schema registry. A terminal report with an unknown version reached READY_FOR_AUTHORIZATION. All inputs were synthetic; issue() was never called.

audit001_findings.title: Nested report failures are not propagated
audit001_findings.description: A top-level PASS with checks[0].status=FAIL/MISSING_FRAMES cleared assessment. Known top-level FAIL still blocks, so the defect is selective rather than a total missing gate.

audit001_findings.title: Supporting evidence can be borrowed across identities or time
audit001_findings.description: Outer proof bindings are checked, but terminal candidate/run/revision/gate fields and their own validity window are not interpreted. Foreign or future terminal reports cleared assessment.

audit001_findings.title: Batch-specific open obligation lists are not recognized by publication
audit001_findings.description: The ledger has81 rows in gaps plus20 other obligation rows. A PASS report with an empty gaps array and an OPEN row in batch020_open_obligations cleared assessment. The actual full ledger still blocks because its81 gaps are open; that is not a fix for incomplete traversal.

audit001_findings.title: Readiness consumers disagree about evidence diagnostics
audit001_findings.description: release_v2 returns READY_FOR_REVIEW for authenticated PASS-labelled evidence with a blocking diagnostic. publication_v2 correctly rejects it. A caller using only the lower API loses this safeguard; it does not itself issue a certificate.

audit001_findings.title: Shared-secret evaluator aliases can satisfy a strengthened quorum
audit001_findings.description: Two out-of-band evaluator aliases sharing one secret met min_distinct_evaluators=2 with distinct report bytes. This is a trusted-store configuration weakness, not an unauthenticated remote bypass. Final publication authority already has a separate same-secret guard.

audit001_findings.title: Integration metadata still advertises Batch020 and only20 namespaces
audit001_findings.description: The actual22 namespaces and continuation disagree with status=LOCAL_BATCH020_ONLY_NOT_INTEGRATED, new_source_namespace=security_v2 and the20-name integration list. Batch021/022 prose notes do not repair a machine reader of those fields.

audit001_findings.title: Task/test identity requires a normalized index
audit001_findings.description: All76 implementation tasks are traceable, but task metadata is spread across tasks/, docs/ and evidence/. The3529 suite-qualified test identities include3515 distinct unqualified unittest IDs:14 names collide across isolated suites. No test is deleted or counted twice within a suite.

audit001_findings.title: Long-form product media exceeds current byte/decode envelopes
audit001_findings.description: SnapshotStore rejects a >16MiB artifact before IO; raw RGB complete decoding is also bounded. This is correct fail-closed behavior but not sufficient for full-resolution multi-minute lessons. Do not remove bounds without streaming coverage.

audit001_findings.title: Native and operational evidence remains separate from synthetic capability tests
audit001_findings.description: The continuation keeps native Remotion, native game origin, acoustic alignment, operational assessors, canonical callers and real-book proof open. Passing this audit regression does not execute those paths anew or clear their obligations.

audit001_findings.title: Production trust, publication and worker scope remains unfinished
audit001_findings.description: Local HMAC/SQLite, fixed sandbox probes and trusted producer measurements remain bounded components, not deployed authority, immutable publication, hostile generated-worker isolation or distributed durability.

audit001_findings.title: Cinematic learning outcomes and correction-memory improvement need explicit evidence
audit001_findings.description: Existing plan validators and finite diagnostics are useful but do not prove the intended explanatory cinematic quality, real learner understanding, multi-domain calibration or measurable improvement through reuse. These remain mandatory QA/EVAL handoff requirements, not claims of this audit.
